g.text: INSTANCE ARCHITECTURE / SGA · PGA · LGWR · DBWn · CKPT
ONE ORACLE INSTANCE / pattern repeated for racdb1 and racdb2
Commit ACK after redo flush · default WAIT semantics
COMMIT waits for redo durability; dirty data blocks are written independently by DBWn.
Saved snapshot: SGA_TARGET 1.5 GiB · MEMORY_TARGET 0 (ASMM) · PGA target 512 MiB / limit 2 GiB.
Saved pre-tuning parameters, not live configuration. Each RAC instance has its own SGA and background processes.
